profile_text.body:
Vercel is a for-profit startup founded in 2015 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA. The company operates v0.dev, and its website describes v0 as a collaborative AI assistant for designing, iterating, and scaling full-stack web applications.

The company's primary tracked AI product is v0, categorized as a coding and developer tool focused on UI generation. Vercel also maintains a presence in the MCP server registry with two listed servers: one described as scanning websites or MCP servers for agent readiness and returning a scored report with fixes, and another described as searching SVG metadata and enabling purchase of licensed commercial SVG exports for coding agents.

The held facts record 174 legal cases with California exposure, though no specific litigation details are provided in the available data.
